title: The usage line on a workspace card is one flat colour and shows a cost Jack does not pay
body:
Each agent on a workspace card in the open sidebar gets a usage line under its state and message. `usage` in `src/server/chrome/frame.rs` builds it from what the agent last reported, leaving out the parts it has not reported:

```text
claude-opus · 62% ctx · 18.4k tok · $0.42
```

The card draws the whole line in one colour, `MUTED`. When the line is wider than the card, `usage` drops the model first.

## Proposal

- The line gets colour. The parts should be told apart at a glance, and the context percent could shift colour as it fills.
- The cost leaves the line. On a subscription the dollar figure is not money Jack spends.

## Open

- Which colours, and whether the context percent changes colour at thresholds.
- Whether the token count stays, once the cost is gone.
- Whether the cost survives anywhere, such as in the `agents` MCP reply, which keeps it whatever the card shows.
